newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse to launch remote access trading.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse to launch remote access trading.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Wednesday it would give brokers remote access to the bourse next month to smooth trading.
"Brokers will be able to trade from their own offices and this will boost the efficiency of their operations," exchange general manager Stere Farmache said.
He said 14 brokerage houses were already benefiting from that facility, which will be extended to all the 74 brokers dealing on the exchange in up to five weeks.
The floor will remain open to brokers willing to trade within the stock exchange, Farmache added.
"It will give us time to process more orders and introduce them into the system. This will boost trading," one said.

"Due to remote access to trading, we will see a rise in second-tier activity because brokers will have enough time to concentrate on smaller caps too," said Dan Barbulescu, Vanguard securities head of research.
The Bucharest bourse lists 40 stocks, including six on the first tier. It holds daily sessions from Monday to Friday.
